<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="tinderGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="6" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".12"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="keyShadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="1" stdDeviation="0" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".18"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="22" y="20" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="315" y1="14" x2="315" y2="20" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="320" y1="12" x2="320" y2="20" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="325" y1="10" x2="325" y2="20" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="330" y1="8" x2="330" y2="20" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="346" cy="15" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="343" y1="15" x2="349" y2="15" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="357" y="9" width="23" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="380" y="13" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="359" y="11" width="17" height="8" rx="2" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="34,67 23,78 34,89" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="52" y="84" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Verify your number</text>
    <line x1="20" y1="108" x2="370" y2="108" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Main verification content -->
  <g>
    <text x="28" y="160" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="34" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Enter code</text>
    <text x="28" y="190" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">We sent a verification code to</text>
    <text x="28" y="218" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="400" fill="#4A4A4A">+1 415 555 0187</text>

    <!-- Code entry slots -->
    <rect x="28" y="260" width="43" height="52" rx="5" fill="#F5F7FA" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="84" y="260" width="43" height="52" rx="5" fill="#F5F7FA" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="140" y="260" width="43" height="52" rx="5" fill="#F5F7FA" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="196" y="260" width="43" height="52" rx="5" fill="#F5F7FA" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="252" y="260" width="43" height="52" rx="5" fill="#F5F7FA" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="308" y="260" width="43" height="52" rx="5" fill="#F5F7FA" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="31" y1="309" x2="68" y2="309" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="49.5" cy="286" r="4" fill="#4A4A4A"/>
    <circle cx="105.5" cy="286" r="4" fill="#4A4A4A"/>
    <circle cx="161.5" cy="286" r="4" fill="#4A4A4A"/>

    <text x="28" y="340" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="300" fill="#939393">Didn't get a code?</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="141" y="320" width="104" height="34" rx="17" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <text x="193" y="342" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#FE3675">RESEND CODE</text>
    </g>
    <text x="28" y="382" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="300" fill="#939393">You can request a new code in 00:27</text>

    <g filter="url(#shadow)">
      <rect x="90" y="408" width="210" height="44" rx="22" fill="#000000" opacity=".08"/>
      <rect x="90" y="404" width="210" height="44" rx="22" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
      <text x="195" y="431" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">CONTINUE</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Navigation bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="472" width="390" height="70" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="18" y1="472" x2="372" y2="472" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
    <g>
      <polygon points="44,492 54,484 64,492 64,505 57,505 57,497 51,497 51,505 44,505" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <text x="54" y="526" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">HOME</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="135" cy="492" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <polygon points="135,485 137,490 142,490 138,493 140,498 135,495 130,498 132,493 128,490 133,490" fill="#939393"/>
      <text x="135" y="526" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">DISCOVER</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="211" y="485" width="22" height="15" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <polygon points="216,500 220,500 216,505" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <text x="222" y="526" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">CHATS</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="325" cy="490" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <ellipse cx="325" cy="504" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <text x="325" y="526" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">PROFILE</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Numeric keypad -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="542" width="390" height="302" fill="#F2F2F6"/>
    <g filter="url(#keyShadow)">
      <rect x="9" y="552" width="118" height="57" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <rect x="136" y="552" width="118" height="57" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <rect x="263" y="552" width="118" height="57" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <rect x="9" y="616" width="118" height="57" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <rect x="136" y="616" width="118" height="57" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <rect x="263" y="616" width="118" height="57" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <rect x="9" y="680" width="118" height="57" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <rect x="136" y="680" width="118" height="57" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <rect x="263" y="680" width="118" height="57" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <rect x="9" y="744" width="118" height="57" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <rect x="136" y="744" width="118" height="57" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <rect x="263" y="744" width="118" height="57" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    </g>

    <text x="68" y="579" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="25" fill="#000000">1</text>
    <text x="195" y="579" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="25" fill="#000000">2</text>
    <text x="322" y="579" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="25" fill="#000000">3</text>
    <text x="68" y="643" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="25" fill="#000000">4</text>
    <text x="195" y="643" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="25" fill="#000000">5</text>
    <text x="322" y="643" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="25" fill="#000000">6</text>
    <text x="68" y="707" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="25" fill="#000000">7</text>
    <text x="195" y="707" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="25" fill="#000000">8</text>
    <text x="322" y="707" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="25" fill="#000000">9</text>
    <text x="68" y="771" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="25" fill="#000000">.</text>
    <text x="195" y="771" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="25" fill="#000000">0</text>
    <polyline points="305,770 319,770 326,763 319,756 305,756" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="305" y1="756" x2="298" y2="763" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="139" y="818" width="112" height="5" rx="3" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>
</svg>
